supported.guidance: Install into ~/.claude/skills. The native executor has credential-format fixture coverage; actual host API and attachment delivery acceptance is pending.
supported.directorySelection: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/skills when explicitly configured; otherwise the default global directory.

supported.guidance: Install into ~/.agents/skills. The native executor has credential-format fixture coverage; actual host API and attachment delivery acceptance is pending.
supported.directorySelection: Use the documented default unless the user explicitly supplies an absolute target.

supported.guidance: Install into ~/.workbuddy/skills. The native executor has credential-format fixture coverage; actual host API and attachment delivery acceptance is pending.
supported.directorySelection: WORKBUDDY_CONFIG_DIR/skills, then CODEBUDDY_CONFIG_DIR/skills when explicitly configured; otherwise the default.

supported.guidance: Install into ~/.gemini/skills. The native executor has credential-format fixture coverage; actual host API and attachment delivery acceptance is pending.
supported.directorySelection: Use ~/.agents/skills when an official Skill already exists there, because Gemini discovers it before ~/.gemini/skills; report lower-priority managed duplicates without deleting them.

supported.guidance: Install into ~/.grok/skills. The native executor has credential-format fixture coverage; actual host API and attachment delivery acceptance is pending.
supported.directorySelection: Use the documented default unless the user explicitly supplies an absolute target.

supported.guidance: Install into the selected OpenCode config root. The native executor has credential-format fixture coverage; actual host API and attachment delivery acceptance is separate.
supported.directorySelection: OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR/skills when explicitly configured; otherwise XDG_CONFIG_HOME/opencode/skills, default ~/.config/opencode/skills. Overrides must be absolute without parent traversal. Doctor checks the loaded root, selected/global roots and documented ~/.agents/skills and ~/.claude/skills compatibility roots, without scanning projects or deleting duplicates.

supported.guidance: The Skills can be installed, but this release has no Trae credential adapter; API commands stop before a request.
supported.directorySelection: Use the documented default unless the user explicitly supplies an absolute target.

supported.guidance: Claude Desktop local Code sessions load Claude Code skills. The executor reads the active Desktop 3P gateway profile, never Claude Code credentials. Cloud/Cowork sandbox access and native attachment delivery require separate real-host acceptance.
supported.directorySelection: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/skills when explicitly configured; otherwise ~/.claude/skills. Shared with Claude Code; select --host claude-desktop for Desktop 3P authentication.

supported.guidance: Install into the local DSH Harness skills directory. On Windows use %APPDATA%/dsh-desktop/harness/skills. Credential fixtures cover the selected provider and its versioned refs store; real-host API and delivery acceptance remain pending.
supported.directorySelection: DSH_HOME/skills when explicitly supplied by the local Harness; otherwise the desktop application-data harness/skills directory. Project/custom roots may shadow it; doctor reports the documented shared Agents root.

supported.guidance: Local ZCode execution only. Resolve one unique enabled Pure Tokens connection; this does not identify the current conversation model. Real-host API and native delivery acceptance remain pending.
supported.directorySelection: ZCODE_DATA_BASE_DIR/.zcode/skills when explicitly configured with an absolute base directory; otherwise ~/.zcode/skills. Remote workspace synchronization does not supply the executor or connection.

supported.guidance: Native executor credential-format fixtures; actual host API and attachment delivery acceptance remains pending.
Native executor credential-format fixtures; actual host API and attachment delivery acceptance remains pending.
supported.directorySelection: QODER_CONFIG_DIR/skills; otherwise QODER_CLI_HOME or home plus QODER_CONFIG_DIR_NAME (default .qoder), then skills.

supported.guidance: Local Pi only. Verify one matching models.json endpoint before checking the same provider ID in sibling auth.json. Supported inline auth takes precedence; dynamic or unrepresented authentication stops without fallback. Real-host API and attachment delivery remain pending.
supported.directorySelection: PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR/skills when explicitly configured with an absolute root without parent traversal; otherwise ~/.pi/agent/skills.

supported.guidance: Local Hermes config.yaml selected custom provider only. Dynamic credentials, routing overrides and nonempty credential pools stop without fallback. Real-host API and delivery acceptance remain pending.
supported.directorySelection: Absolute HERMES_HOME/skills; otherwise ~/.hermes/skills on macOS/Linux. Windows uses LOCALAPPDATA/hermes/skills, with legacy ~/.hermes only when the current root is absent.

supported.guidance: Local canonical settings.json and auth.yaml, with consistent selected provider/model/default instance. Legacy stores stop without migration. Real-host API and delivery acceptance remain pending.
supported.directorySelection: Absolute EVOX_AGENT_DIR or EVOX_CODING_AGENT_DIR plus skills; conflicting overrides stop. Otherwise ~/.evox/agent/skills.

supported.guidance: Local VS Code default profile customendpoint file only. Exactly one matching model with an inline Bearer header is supported; multiple matching models are ambiguous, not proof of an active chat selection. Portable, named and remote profiles are not supported. Real-host acceptance remains pending.
supported.directorySelection: Use ~/.copilot/skills; doctor also reports documented shared ~/.agents/skills and ~/.claude/skills duplicates without deleting them.

supported.guidance: Local Octop SQLite only. Read the saved default connection, or a unique enabled matching service when no default exists, in a read-only WAL-aware transaction. No global Skill directory or current conversation selection is inferred. Real-host acceptance remains pending.
supported.directorySelection: Explicit absolute --target / -Target for the current local agent workspace's .octop/skills; never enumerate agents or use the global skill-package store. OCTOP_HOME selects only the connection root.
